1.0.0.en: First release. Predicts your car's departure and arrival times from your EV charger's connection state, entirely locally, and exposes them as Flow cards for price-aware charging. Easee chargers start with real history straight away, seeded from Homey Insights.

1.4.0.en: New: predicts how many kWh your car will need tomorrow, learned from your charger's own energy meter and seeded from Homey Insights so it shows real numbers from the start. It learns your weekly pattern (a commuting day reads higher than a quiet weekend) and comes with a low/high band. Available as a capability, a Flow condition (daily need above X kWh) and a trigger, so your energy Flows can size a charge or skip the plan when the car barely needs a top-up. Once a day is over, the timeline shows how the prediction compared with what the car actually used.

1.4.4.en: Publish automatically on every push to main; Add CI and a manual publish-to-App-Store workflow; Keep forecasting today's departure while the car is still home
